release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.21 - UI Improvements & Bug Fixes:
- Fixed dark mode toggle crash on web platform
- Enhanced real-time chat sorting for individual and group chats
- Improved unread message indicators (red dot with shadow, bold text)
- Fixed Android 10 video playback issues (automatic download fallback)
- Enhanced reply message UI with better visual context
- Improved chat list real-time updates without manual refresh
- Better error handling and state management
- All features verified across Web, Android, and iOS platforms
